name: Add Pharmacy References
action_description: Creates one pharmacy_references record per pharmacy entry in the extracted pharmacies JSON, linked to the given phone call and contact

inputs.name: extracted_pharmacies_json
inputs.label: Extracted Pharmacies JSON
inputs.description: JSON array string of validated pharmacy objects, each with name_verbatim, cleaned_name, type, usage_status, geographic_search, etc.

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the current call summary record. Used to associate the pharmacy reference record with the call summary.
